tweets.text: I wish there were more exchange programs whereby people could get exposure to teams working in new/interesting ways (w/o leaving their jobs).

Oh I wish I could help more companies see the cycle of insanity that starts with high WIP

So many unintended/damaging/stressful effects ... that then get treated as “the problem”.

#reduceWIP

Some of the best roadmaps...
* mention 0 features
* use no shorthand (e.g. "redesign V2.0")
* are not on a timeline (have no dates)
* mention Who and Why
* tell a compelling story
* acknowledge uncertainty
* set qual and quant goals
* embrace incremental delivery

#youcandoit!

We need a new wave of thoughtful managers and leaders ... with experience on the front lines ... optimistic, ethical, humane systems thinkers

A byproduct of demonizing middle management is that we’re discouraging this.
